spanish: Honra a tu padre y a tu madre, a fin de que se alarguen tus días sobre el suelo que Jehová tu Dios dando a ti.

findings.issue: Hiphil imperfect 3mp has the plural days as subject and only paragogic nun, with no object. Middle 'se alarguen' smooths that intransitive hiphil without adding a causer or shifting the subject.
The qal active participle is the predicate of the relative clause. Bare gerund 'dando' keeps the non-finite form but does not complete the Spanish predication.

notes: לך is 2fs; 'a ti' remains 2sg and does not mark gender.
